description: Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply - Order to acquire the land in Medagama, Hansagiripara, Bendiyamulla & Seedevimawatha D/S Division, Gampaha District for waste supply projects
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains multiple orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific land parcels (immovable property) for wastewater treatment facilities. Each order includes detailed descriptions of the land locations, boundaries, extents, and village details. While a minister is named (Rauff Hakeem), this is incidental to the core purpose of the document, which is land acquisition for public projects. The content fits the Land Gazette category as it focuses on "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "land development projects."
